notes.title: 7月27日更新公告
notes.content:
1.修复【彼岸】【死亡大道】所添加的复活次数不会存档的bug
2.增加【彼岸】关于复活次数的基础伤害计算
3.重做自爆蜘蛛的自爆效果，增加1秒爆炸延迟，但范围扩大
4.修复某些法宝会对自身施加负面效果的bug
5.魔始难度精英小怪的伤害buff调低，增加移动速度buff
6.法宝【噬灵血玉】消耗残魄量降低为15%
7.修复境界【不可直视之神】依旧会消耗残魄的bug
8.修复境界神通【国运龙气】可以一直使用的bug
9.境界【邪祟之主】调整为残魄获取效率增幅15%
10.境界【地府之君】调整为消耗残魄增幅20%，已消耗残魄计算数值增幅10%
11.境界【涉足轮回】受到伤害降低 10%，消耗残魄时获得 50 残魄
12.调整修炼流派 【逆天】伤害区间的随机算法，现在随机区间变为完全随机并且根据区间上下限变化，不会为一半减伤一半增伤
13.境界神通【斗转星移】效果修改为：消耗 1层天道紫气，气运增幅20%，当前历练结束时有5% 几率获得双倍掉落，随后移除所有层数（层数可无限叠加，但每次叠加释放天道紫气消耗翻倍，每次双倍掉落效果单独计算，双倍概率受到气运以及天道宝物品质影响）

notes.title: V1.22 Update丨Fixes & Adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[*] Bug that the disaster strength of the equipment glacier disaster incorrectly adds to the freezing strength.

 [h2]Adjusted[/h2]
 [h3]Ice Avenue:[/h3]
[*] The third level of the Avenue has a new effect: every 100 energy flow increases the freezing strength by 1%.
[*] The weapon [Frost] has a new effect: when attacking normally, it applies 5 Frozen Dao.
[*] The move [Frost on the Bone] reduces the freezing resistance and can be affected by negative effects, but the basic value is reduced from 20% to 5%.
[*] The magic weapon [Ice Feather] has been changed to: when dodging, the freezing effect is increased (10% free effect), which lasts for 5 seconds.
[*] The magic weapon [Ice Pendant] has been changed to: the freezing strength is increased by 5%.
[*] The magic weapon [Water Ice Pearl] has been changed to: after freezing the enemy, the buff effect is obtained Xuanbing: the freezing effect is increased by 10%, which lasts 10 seconds, when gaining the buff effect, gain 0.5 disaster effect.
[*] Magic weapon [Ice and Snow Lotus] changed to: directly take it after obtaining it, increase all attributes by 500 and freeze strength by 100%, then destroy it. If the Ice and Snow Lotus is repaired, it will bloom permanently, and each experience will increase all attributes by 10 and freeze strength by 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [Cold Light Jade Guard] changed to: freeze strength increase by 8%, Nine Nether Sealing Heaven Style range expanded by 60%, and additional ice seal law increased by 50.
[*] Magic weapon [Green Cold Jade] attribute adjusted to: freeze strength increase by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Cold Mirror] changed to: freeze strength increase by 15%, ignore 15% freeze resistance when applying Ice Seal Law.
[*] Magic weapon [Mysterious Ice Armor] changed to: freeze strength increase 30%.

 [h3]Sword Avenue/Mind Avenue[/h3]
[*] Sword Avenue 1, 2, 3, 4 levels of damage increase changed to 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%.
[*] Sword Avenue 4 level added effect: Every time you learn a Sword Avenue move, the damage caused by Sword Avenue moves will be increased by 20%.
[*]Mind Avenue 1 level added effect: When a flying object causes damage, it will cause additional (40% energy flow * flying object damage) damage.
[*] Mind Avenue 2 level energy flow duration changed from 5 seconds to 10 seconds.
[*] Mind Avenue 3 level added effect: Every 100 energy flow increases flying object damage by 1%.
[*] Magic weapon [Green Shadow Flying Sword] changed to: Flying object damage increase by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Sword Soul] changed to: Flying object damage increase by 30%.
[*] New magic weapon [Clear Heart Lamp] Flying object damage increase by 15%, when releasing realm magic, permanently increase flying object damage by 1%.
[*] Mind Avenue move damage calculation generally increased by 20%.

[h3]The Great Way of Gold:[/h3]
[*] The weapon [Slashing Edge] removes the negative effect of reduced life acquisition efficiency, and the attack power is increased to 50%.
[*] The skill [Aurora Piercing Spear] increases the gold aura obtained each time it is released from 1 layer to 2 layers.
[*] The skill [Broken Golden Light] is changed to: increase the armor-breaking effect by 10%, increase the gold aura conversion rate by 10%, and reduce the enemy's (100% armor-breaking effect) defense when causing damage.
[*]The skill [Immortal Golden Body] passive effect is changed to release immortal gold patterns when hit, causing ((20% attack power + 20% defense power + 10% shield) * hit effect) to the surrounding area, and obtain a layer of gold aura, and the gold aura obtained when actively released is increased from 2 layers to 3 layers.
[*] The skill [War Field] is changed to infinite duration, and the interval for obtaining gold aura is changed to 5 seconds.
[*] The magic weapon [Hunyuan Bipolar Pearl] is changed to: obtain 1 when critically hit.
[*] The magic weapon [Golden Spirit Stone] is changed to: attack power increase by 20%, attack special effect with (30% attack power) damage.
[*] The magic weapon [Golden Brilliance Long Protection] is changed to: gain 1 layer of golden spirit every 5 seconds, and the conversion rate of golden spirit increases by 5%.

[h3]Destruction Avenue:[/h3]
[*] All destruction moves remove all applied armor-breaking buffs.
[*] The first layer of Destruction Avenue adds a new effect: all damage caused ignores (5% armor-breaking effect) defense, ignores armor over 100%, and increases damage by 1% for every 1% over 1%.
[*] The Destruction Avenue's destructive momentum cancels the armor-breaking effect gain and changes it to a fixed gain. First layer: 5% damage and 5% anti-interruption. Second layer: 5% damage. Third layer: 5% all attributes. Fourth level: 3% final damage.
[*] Magic weapon [Stone of Gold] changed to: Armor-breaking effect increased by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Spirit of Destruction] changed to: Armor-breaking effect increased by 25%.
[*] Magic weapon [War Horn] changed to: Armor-breaking effect increased by 15%.
[*] 
[h3]Great Way of Fire:[/h3]
[*] The flame effect increase of the fourth level of Great Way of Fire increased from 8% to 20%.
[*] Magic weapon [Fire Spirit Stone] changed to: Flame damage interval reduced by 10%, flame damage increased by 20%.
[*] Magic weapon [Red Fierce Stone] changed to: Flame damage increased by 5%, when triggering magic weapon damage, 1 layer of flame is superimposed at the same time.
[*] Magic weapon [Divine Fire Pearl] changed to: Flame damage increased by 15%, additional damage (10% adaptive + 10% energy flow) for flame.
[*] Magic weapon [Flame Dragon Token] changed to: Flame damage increased by 5%.

[h3]Great Way of Arrays:[/h3]
[*] The second level of Great Way of Arrays adds a new effect: For each array, the damage caused is increased 5% array effect.
[*] New effect added to the third level of the array avenue: the attack array will automatically track the enemy, and for each array that exists, the damage caused will be increased by an additional 3% array effect.
[*] New effect added to the fourth level of the array avenue: the buff array will be transformed into an array wheel and last forever, gaining the effects of all buff arrays, and for each array that exists, the damage caused will be increased by an additional 8% array effect.
[*] The array effect of the move [Star Array] has been modified to reduce the flow time by 2% when the move is released.
[*] New magic weapon [Array Heart Jade]: Each time a formation is cast, a basic attribute is randomly increased (1% array effect). If it is randomly for health, it is changed to increase (10% array effect).
[*] New magic weapon [Flying Wing Mask]: The array effect is increased by 10%, and the free and easy effect is increased after the array is cast (20% array effect), which lasts for 10 seconds.
[*]New magic weapon [Talisman Array Spirit Edge]: The magic weapon is regarded as a move of the array avenue, and the array effect is increased 25%, generates a Nine-Thunder Heavenly Array that covers the world. When casting the array, summons a Nine-Heavenly Divine Thunder to a random (100% array effect) enemy, causing (50% adaptive * array effect) damage.
[*] Magic weapon [Amulet Array Jade] changed to: Array effect increased by 8%, array duration increased by 2 seconds.
[*] Magic weapon [Concentrated Jade] changed to: Array effect increased by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Golden Pattern Spirit Array Jade] changed to: Array effect increased by 15%, and the damage received is reduced by 1% for each array.

[h3]Phantom Avenue:[/h3]
[*] The number of additional attacks on the second level of Phantom Avenue increased from 1 to 2.
[*] The third level of Phantom Avenue changed to: every 300% of normal attack damage increases the number of attacks by 1.
[*] The fourth level of Phantom Avenue removes the damage reduction effect.
[*] Magic weapon [Phoenix Pendant] changed to: normal attack damage increased by 15%.
[*] Magic weapon [Illusionary Dao Blade] changed to: regarded as a Phantom Avenue move, normal attack damage increased 25%, additional (80% adaptive) damage for normal attacks.
[*] Magic weapon [Walker's Cloak] is changed to: Xiaoyao effect and normal attack damage increase by 15%.
[*] Magic weapon [Purple Cloud Jade] is changed to: When attacking normally, additional attack effect: additional (30% adaptive) damage.

 [h3]Xiaoyao Avenue:[/h3]
[*] The triggering effect of successful dodge is moved from the second layer to the fourth layer, and the triggering interval is 10 seconds.
[*] The damage of successful dodge is changed to: second layer - 20%, third layer - 15%, fourth layer - 30%.

[h3]Thunder Avenue:[/h3]
[*] Remove the effect of adding burst damage based on critical hit rate, add burst damage increase, and the increase value is the same as the critical hit rate.

[h3]Other magic weapons are adjusted:[/h3]
[*] Magic weapon [Corpse Gourd] is changed to: negative effect increase by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Witch Bracelet] is changed to: health increase by 15%.
[*] Magic weapon [Purple Clouds Bag] is changed to: luck increase by 8%.
[*] Magic weapon [Magic Power Fragments] is changed to: the magic weapon is regarded as a bond of the Great Way of Slaughter, the killing effect is increased by 25%, the damage is increased by 10%, and the negative effects on the self are reduced by 50%.
[*] Magic weapon [God-walking Banner] is changed to: free and easy effect increase by 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [Slaughter Eye Pearl] is changed to: killing effect increase by 20%.
[*] Magic weapon [Water Spirit Stone] is changed to: the magic weapon is regarded as a bond of the Great Way of Water, the buff effect count is increased by 3, and the buff effect is increased by 20%.
[*] Magic weapon [Earth Spirit Stone] is changed to: the magic weapon is regarded as a bond of the Great Way of Earth, defense is increased 25%, when standing still, the final damage received is reduced by 2% per second, up to 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [Wood Spirit Stone] is changed to: the magic weapon is regarded as the bond of the Great Way of Wood, the life acquisition efficiency is increased by 25%, the amount of pill recovery is increased by 20%, and 3% of the life value is restored when casting a move.
[*] Magic weapon [Soul Gathering Pill] is changed to: the amount of residual souls obtained is increased by 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [Blood Emperor Martial Book] has a new effect: the life value is increased by 25%, and the blood force damage is increased by 15%.
[*] Magic weapon [Fire Hell Stone] is changed to: the damage received and the damage caused are increased by 15%.
[*] Magic weapon [Phoenix Feather Clothes] damage is increased from 25% adaptive to 60% adaptive.
[*] Magic weapon [Light Spirit Long Shoes] is changed to: the free and easy effect is increased by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Energy Array] is changed to: the energy flow is increased by 25%, the spiritual effect is increased 10%, energy acquisition efficiency increased by 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [Spiritual Mysterious Jade] changed to: energy increased by 15%, trigger attack special effects when causing damage, and cause additional (50% energy value) damage.
[*] Magic weapon [Shui Xin Jade] changed to: buff effect increased by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Gold Ingot] changed to: luck increased by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Chaos Green Gourd] changed to: magic weapon is regarded as the bond of the Great Dao of Wind, movement speed increased by 25%, luck increased by 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [Hongmeng Liangyi Qi] changed to: magic weapon is regarded as the bond of the Great Dao of Yin and Yang, Yin and Yang moves damage increased by 20%, Yin moves damage increased by 10%, Yang moves damage increased by 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [Innate Thunder Lotus] changed to: magic weapon is regarded as the bond of the Great Dao of Thunder, critical hit rate increased by 25%, and critical hit rate increased by 1% after each experience.
[*] Magic weapon [Yellow Spring Bone] negative effect increased by 20% changed to Increase by 20%.
[*] Magic weapon [Guardian Jade] is changed to: Magic weapon is regarded as a guardian avenue bond, shield acquisition amount is increased by 20%, and the attack effect is increased by 20%.
[*] Magic weapon [Book of Stars] is changed to: Attack power is increased by 10%, and attack power effect is increased by 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [World Foundation] is changed to: Defense power is increased by 10%, and defense power effect is increased by 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [Heavenly Cauldron] is changed to: Luck increase by 15%, and the additional damage after upgrading is changed to (200% luck).
[*] Magic weapon [Life Spirit Pearl] is changed to: Life acquisition effect is increased by 15%, and health value is increased by 20%.
[*] Magic weapon [Thunder Emperor Armor] Shield acquisition amount is changed to Increase by 8%.
[*] Magic weapon [Flying Leaf Amulet] is changed to: Life recovery efficiency is increased by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Spiritual Jade Book] is changed to: Residual Soul acquisition amount is increased by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Spirit Devouring Blood Jade] is changed to: Residual Soul consumption is increased by 100%, and the residual soul acquisition amount is increased 15%.

[*] Magic weapon [Red Talisman Blood Order] changed to: Killing effect increase by 5%.
[*] Magic weapon [Red Flame Soul Blade] changed to: Killing effect increase by 10%.
[*] Magic weapon [Yellow Spring Soul Bead] changed to: Treated as a Soul Avenue move, the amount of residual souls obtained increased by 25%, when releasing Soul Avenue moves, 1% of residual souls are counted as consumed residual souls.

[*]The new effect of [First Glimpse of the Alchemy Realm] in the Alchemy Realm: When using an elixir, permanently obtain (2* elixir recovery) all attributes and 1% elixir recovery.

[*] The new effect of [Original Dao Heart] in the Alchemy Realm: Increase the damage caused by 10%.
[*] The damage increase of the Alchemy Realm [Suppressing the World] is increased from 10% to 20%.
[*] Realm magical powers will be added according to the anti-interruption, elixir recovery amount, and shield acquisition amount.
[*] Alchemy realm [Medicine Path Alchemy] adds a new effect: shield acquisition amount increases by 15%, anti-interruption effect increases by 15%.
[*] Alchemy realm [Extreme Qi] is changed to: elixir recovery efficiency increases by 15%, shield acquisition increases by 20%.
[*] Alchemy realm [Eternal Invincibility] is changed to: elixir recovery efficiency increases by 15%, anti-interruption effect increases by 20%.

[*] Dark side realm [Ancient Broken Road] is changed to: damage increases by 35%, killing effect increases by 10%.

[*] Zuowang Dao Realm [When the Real is Fake] Added effect: The gain effect after conversion is doubled.
[*] Zuowang Dao Realm [Zuowang Dao] Modified to: Damage received and damage reduced by 35%.
[*] Zuowang Dao Realm [Seemingly Foolish and Fake] Modified to: Damage received and damage reduced by 50%.
[*] Demon Dao Realm [Heart Demons] Damage increase increased to 25%.
[*] Demon Dao Realm [Heart Locked Demons] Damage increase increased to 35%.

After death, the player will enter the abyss, and then consume (10%) all attributes to wake up from the abyss. When the loss exceeds 20%, there is a chance of permanent death each time they die. (The more attributes consumed, the higher the probability of death. For every additional 1% of all attributes consumed, there is a 1% chance of permanent death).
[*] The magic realm [Fishing for All Living Things] has a new effect: you can consume an additional 10% in the abyss before you start to welcome death.
[*] The magic realm [Soul Refining All Spirits] has a new effect: you can consume an additional 10% in the abyss before you start to welcome death.

[*] The upper limit of the random interval of the heaven-defying realm [The Stars Fall into the Universe] has been increased from 50% to 150%.
[*] The upper limit of the random interval of the heaven-defying realm [The Heaven-defying Realm Changes Fate] has been increased from 100% to 300%.
[*] The upper limit of the random interval of the heaven-defying realm [One-pointed Destiny] is increased from 200% to 500%.
[*] The basic realm [Heavenly Golden Pill] is changed to: all attributes increase by 10%, damage increase by 5%.
[*] The basic realm [Heavenly Yuanying] is changed to: all attributes increase by 10%, damage increase by 20%.
[*] The basic realm [Heavenly Yuanshen] is changed to: all attributes increase by 15%, damage increase by 20%, and the adaptive damage calculation is corrected from taking the highest value to taking the average value of all attributes.

notes.title: April 17 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the sound effect of 【Sword from the West】 was being released repeatedly.

Fixed a bug where the sound effect of 【Sword Storm】 would disappear when special effects were triggered.

Fixed a bug causing abnormal attack animations in the 4th segment of 【Taichi】.

Fixed a bug where 【Way of Freedom】 was missing damage bonuses.

Added a new 【Freedom】 upgrade option in realm attributes.

Adjusted the 2nd tier effect of 【Way of Freedom】:

Old: "Freedom-triggered attack effects +1"

New: "Every 10 seconds counts as 1 successful dodge. After dodging, increase damage by (30% of Freedom effect) for 3 seconds."

Adjusted the 3rd tier effect of 【Way of Freedom】:

Old: "Freedom-triggered attack effects +1"

New: "Every additional 100% Freedom effect grants +1 Freedom attack count, reduces dodge interval by 3s. After dodging, further increases damage by (20% of Freedom effect) for 3 seconds."

Adjusted the 4th tier effect of 【Way of Freedom】:

Old: "Freedom-triggered attack effects +2"

New: "Reduces dodge interval by 4s. After dodging, further increases damage by (50% of Freedom effect) for 3 seconds."

Enhanced weapon 【Nine Heavens】:

Normal attacks now count as dodges.

Charge multiplier now scales with Freedom effect.

Readjusted attack sound effects for 【Cloud Piercer】 and 【Sword Across the Cosmos】.

Fixed a bug where equipping 【Cloud Piercer】 would cause the dodge skill 【Sword Movement Art】's VFX to disappear and deal abnormal damage.

Buffed 【Cloud Piercer】's base stats: Now grants +1 Spirit Sword regeneration speed by default.

Reworked 【Sword Spirit Communion】:

Removed Spirit Sword value bonus.

Now increases projectile damage by 20%.

Reset the Heavenly Dao realm and adjusted the 【Purple Qi of Heaven】 skill effects.

Fixed bugs in the Human Emperor realm and implemented the 【Dragon Qi of National Fortune】 skill.

Enhanced attributes of the Stellar Shift realm.

notes.title: Free DLC has been released - New weapons and spells
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081834/595b2555791c5236de56e9a8ce18d9d784a7c31f.jpg[/img]

Since its Full Release, thanks to all of you guys entered the world of mirrors to defeat the evils and demons.

However, the disasters are endless...

Let me help you and provide you with 3 swords and 17 Gems!

With the help of these ancient artifacts and gems, you will be able to travel freely through the world of mirrors!

[b]This free DLC [three disasters and seven difficulties] will be automatically updated to the game of players who have purchased[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081834/a01981e085e1fa38272e4e4e5ad9850e44c04189.png[/img]

[b][The Other Side][/b]
‘I am the other side of the sea of suffering.’

All attributes increased by 15%
Killing Avenue no longer applies negative effects and gains 0.5% wood armour when killing
Soul Avenue moves only consume the same percentage of Wooden Armour and count towards consumed Spirit Remnants, and the efficiency of Spirit Remnant acquisition will increase the Wooden Armour limit.
When applying a negative effect, you gain 1% Wooden Armour
Wooden Armour will no longer lower your defence, and when it is consumed, you gain the same percentage of Other Side's Will.
If you reach 100%, you can consume all of your Intent to cast the Sword of the Other Side, burying everything, then entering the Spirit World for 2 seconds and treating it as 1 resurrection.


[b][Nine Nights][/b]
‘Free and easy, travelling through the nine heavens.’

Increases movement speed by 30%.
Attacks triggered by Easy are increased by 1.
Press and hold the Attack button to store power, and release it to release the Nine Heavenly Slashes.
If you press Dodge while storing up power, you can cast Nine Heavens Chop, which deals additional movement speed-related damage to the enemy in front of you, and is treated as Dodge when attacking, and the damage of the triggered Free Attack effect can be increased by the storing up power.

[b][Final Havoc][/b]
‘Final Havoc’.

Conversion Result
Disaster Strength is increased by 40%.
Gain (10% Disaster Strength) Disaster Power after hitting with an Attack Attack.
Gain (10% Strike Damage) Catastrophe Power after a Strike Attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081834/290c72c527ccac83cb364bd8c054ee7242adeaba.png[/img]

[b][Ancient Remnant Bells][/b]
‘Ancient bells left over from an unknown time, covered in disrepair and exuding an ancient aura.’

Immediately upon obtaining it, one mana owned from the previous reincarnation is gained, gaining the power of catastrophe based on the grade of the mana obtained, and subsequently destroying the current mana.


[b][Thunder Calamity Dharma Ring][/b]
‘A mana ring that gathers the power of Thunder Calamity, containing disaster within an inch of its life.’

Increases the chance of a bludgeon by 10%
When triggering a double bludgeon, there is a 1% chance to destroy the current mana, after destroying the mana, you gain a permanent effect Thunder Karma: When bludgeoning, you gain 1 Disaster Power, this effect is stackable.

[b][Plague Jade Jewellery][/b]
‘A jade jade biscuit symbolising the plague, with a number of unknown liquids flowing out of it.’

When a stance or normal attack deals damage, it has a 20% chance to apply 1 tier of negative effects Pestilence: deals (0.1% Catastrophe Power * Bludgeon Damage * Catastrophe Strength) damage per second, stacks for 3 tiers.
Level up after 500 deaths of the unit affected by Pestilence.
When a move or normal attack deals damage, it has a 50% chance to apply 1 tier of negative effects Pestilence: deals (0.1% Catastrophe Power * Bludgeon Damage * Catastrophe Strength) damage per second, stacks up to 5 tiers.

[b][Spirit Transformation Seal][/b]
‘Originally a seal left by an immortal, it was affected by the power of disaster and gained the power of Spiritual Transformation from the Seven Tribulations.’

Stance flow time increased by 20%
Upgrade after passing 12 rooms
1.Energy consumption increased by 50%, stance flow time increased by 20%, final damage increased by 50%.
2.Energy consumption increased by 100%, energy recovery efficiency increased by 100%.
3. Decrease stance flow time by 20%, increase energy flow by 40

[b][Heart Soul Pot][/b]
‘A kettle containing the power of the mind, the power of which can be refined at any time’

After passing through 3 rooms you can choose to have your mind and soul refined, you can choose to refine the remnants of the spirit into the power of disaster, or the power of disaster into the remnants of the spirit


[b][Sword of Calamity][/b]
‘Resembles the dwelling body of the world's disasters, entwined with the power of calamity.’

During a normal attack, fire Calamity Sword Aura, which deals ((5% Adaptive + 0.5% Calamity Power) * Bludgeon Damage * Calamity Strength) damage
Normal Attack: After 1000 attacks, ascend to the next level.
On a Normal Attack, fire Calamity Sword Aura, which deals ((8% Adaptive + 1% Catastrophe Power) * Bludgeon Damage * Catastrophe Strength) damage

[b][Taotie Treasure Vase][/b]
‘Rumoured to be made from the head of a Taotie, it contains the reborn Taotie Spirit’

After killing 100 units, you gain Taotie Spirit Assist, which is consumed after the next attack, then absorbs the current attack and converts it into 50 Catastrophe Power and improves your full attributes by 5. (Improved attributes are affected by the kill effect)

[b][Fire Blasting Fan][/b]
‘Made by a disciple of the Water Sect of the Five Elements Sect, it is specifically designed to restrain the Fire Sect.’

Causes the power of flames to wrap around the magic weapon and will convert the burning flames into a shield every 5 seconds that passes
Upgraded after 500 flames.
Wraps the treasure in the power of flames and converts burning flames into a shield twice every 5 seconds.

[b][Water Ice Pearl][/b]
‘An undersea pearl from the Domain of Extreme Cold, fusing the powers of the Water Avenue and the Ice Avenue.’

After gaining the gain effect, you can ignore 10% Frozen Resistance for 2 seconds and gain 0.5 Catastrophe Power

[b][Nine Calamities Divine Fire Wheel][/b]
‘An object of the Fire Emperor of the Calamity, after the Calamity of the Ten Thousand Realms had passed, it was sealed to the bottom of the sea in the Extreme Cold Domain, and due to unknown reasons it broke the seal and disappeared without a trace’

Every time you go through an adventure you experience 1 tribulation, each tribulation randomly gains 100~200 power of disaster and gains random effects, after 9 tribulations all effects are reset and 1000 power of disaster is gained

[b][Heart Demon Rune Seal][/b]
‘A rune seal containing a heart demonic calamity, created to draw out the heart demons of others.’

When casting a move, consume 10% of your current life value then gain the appropriate Disaster Power based on the life value consumed and increase the damage dealt by 30% for 5 seconds at 5 second intervals (0.1% conversion rate)
Upgrade after consuming 50,000 life points
When casting a move, consume 10% of your current life value and then gain the power of disaster according to the life value consumed, and increase the damage dealt by 40% for 10 seconds at 5 second intervals (0.15% conversion rate)

[b][Spiritual Transformation Crystal][/b]
‘A mother crystal of heaven and earth affected by Spiritual Transformation, with a strong aura of Spiritual Transformation’

Energy consumption increased by 30%, flow time increased by 15%, and damage taken reduced by 20%.
Upgrade after 500 moves.
Energy consumption increased by 40%, flow time increased by 20%, damage taken reduced by 30

[b][Soldier Blood Nucleus][/b]

Summons a Soldier Ghost every 10 seconds to attack an enemy for 20 seconds, each Soldier Ghost has (100% of Catastrophe Power) Life and (10% of Catastrophe Power) Attack Power.
Summon 100 Soldier Ghosts and level up
Summon 1 Soldier Ghost to attack the enemy every 10 seconds for 30 seconds, each Soldier Ghost has (150% Catastrophe Power) Life and (15% Catastrophe Power) Attack Power.

[b][Beggar's Cup of Desolation][/b]
‘A broken cup, once synonymous with famine and plunder.’

Increases damage taken by all units by 15% and reduces movement speed by 15%
Upgraded after passing 10 rooms.
All units take 20% more damage and their movement speed is reduced by 20%.

[b][Pillar of Ancient Evil][/b]
‘A section of an unknown column inscribed with the Dao of Disaster, he can be activated by possessing enough power of disaster’

The Evil God Pillar has no effect, but acquiring a dao that has the power of catastrophe present will activate special abilities based on the amount acquired...

[b][Sickness Hipped Token][/b]
‘Shares the same origin as the plague, and is the property of the Plague Emperor.’

Negative effects are increased by 30%.
If Pestilence Jade Jewel (2nd level) is present, increase the number of stackable layers of the applied negative effect Pestilence by (100% of the negative effect) and increase the base damage of Pestilence by 20

[b][Sanjiu Polar Mirror][/b]
‘Rumour has it that a certain great power sealed the Three Nine Heavens into the mirror.’

After taking damage, cast Sanjiu Mirror Reverse on all surrounding units, applying 50 Ice Seal Dao, triggering interval 2 seconds
Freeze 200 enemies and level up.
After taking damage, cast Sanjiu Mirror Reverse on all enemy units in a wide area, apply 50 Ice Seal Dao Rules, trigger interval 2 secs

If you have any questions for feedback or suggestions, feel free to join [url=https://discord.gg/yRyD7KzQBF]DISCORD[/url] and share with us!

在这新春佳节即将来临之际，愿您们与家人团聚、欢笑不断，心想事成，龙年大吉！

我们由衷地感谢您们一路以来的支持与信任！在过去的一年中，我们经过不懈的努力，进行了30余次的更新，对游戏进行了全面升级。

今年，我们将继续保持初心，不断追求卓越，将会逐步更新以下内容：

[h3][b]剧情更新[/b][/h3]
我们正在精心制作与游戏背景及设定相关的新剧情内容，让您在镜中世界中结识更多精彩的NPC，聆听更多的故事。

[h3][b]引导优化[/b][/h3]
我们将同步更新引导系统，根据您的宝贵反馈，打造更为专业的系统和关卡流程，让初次踏入镜中世界的您能够更快地掌握游戏要领，尽情沉浸在海山世界的奇妙之中。

[h3][b]解锁新功能[/b][/h3]
为了确保您在游戏中能够享受到更为流畅、更为丰富的体验，我们将推出全新的解锁系统，随着您对游戏的深入了解，逐步开放更多的功能和道具，不再一次性将一切都呈现给您。同时，我们也将在关卡内添加更多的探索元素，供您收集隐藏的宝物。

以上即是我们即将进行的更新计划。如果您有任何反馈或建议，我们真诚地邀请您加入我们的QQ群：339130215，期待与您共同探讨、交流。

衷心地感谢您们的支持与陪伴！

祝您们《海山》中度过美好时光！

致以最诚挚的祝福，

《海山》制作组 敬上
2024年2月7日

notes.title: 1月19日更新公告
notes.content:
[h2][b]各位越境者，大家好[/b][/h2]
经过长时间的测试与完善，我们十分兴奋的宣布，存档系统正式上线了！
每当各位进入新的房间时，系统便会自动存档，新版本的主界面也新增了“继续游戏”选项。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081834/3267ed0ec49a067b372248f369b68b3b1e682b8b.png[/img]

除了存档系统以外，每个大关卡都新增了独特精英房间供越境者挑战
新增了新的BOSS“混沌”，作为《海山》的最终BOSS，目前还只是初版，我们正不断的对其进行优化调整
其他更新依旧是进行优化以及bug的修复，具体内容如下：

[h2]新增内容[/h2]
[list]
[*] 新增存档系统
[*] 新增精英房间
[*] 新增效果，气运会对暴击几率进行加成，并且当气运过高时有几率造成双重暴击。
[*] 新增五行大道相生相克效果。
[*] 新增最终BOSS（测试版）
[/list]

[h2]优化更新[/h2]
[list]
[*] 优化游戏卡顿问题
[*] 优化游戏数值
[*] 优化场景效果
[*] 修复无尽关卡无法继续前行的bug
[*] 修复炼化词条显示出错的bug
[*] 修复在藏书阁进入地牢的交互会卡死的bug
[*] 修复返回菜单会卡死的bug
[*] 修复【青木符】和【龙魂护符】在护盾流无效的bug
[*] 修复【山玛瑙】不会被守护触发的bug
[*] 修复【雷之大道】会把增益加给怪物的bug
[*] 修复金灵气会被水之大道延长持续时间的bug
[*] 修复【青龙乙木阵】回血算作命中自己并且能触发额外伤害的bug
[*] 修复了【滴血重生】和【不死不灭】会无限复活的bug
[*] 修复【引魂诀】只生效了一半的bug
[*] 修复神话难度没有【渡劫】境界的bug
[/list]

[h2]其他调整[/h2]
[list]
[*] 【滴血重生】复活后降低的生命值从20%提升至50%
[*] 【镜花水月阵】【醉酒之道】从招式中移除
[*] 【烈火焚身】同时归属于【土之大道】，新增效果每1%额外的火焰伤害提高0.15%防御
[*] 【不灭金身】归属于【土之大道】，效果增强并且一半效果改为防御力增幅
[*] 【九幽封天式】从【土之大道】移除
[*] 【大地之势】归属于【金之大道】，并且伤害新增攻击力计算比例
[*] 【天绝剑意】【震霄分光剑】【青龙乙木阵】归属于【水之大道】，并且会根据增益数量计算伤害。
[*] 【血浪滔天】归属于【木之大道】，并且会根据当前生命值造成额外伤害。
[*] 【灵魂大道】新增效果，命中时将获得一定残魄，并且残魄达到一定数量时，额外提高伤害。
[*] 【引魂诀】获得固定残魄效果降低，并且新增残魄获取效率提高10%
[*] 【噬命夺魄斩】伤害提高，并且新增命中一名敌人获得5残魄
[*] 【万魂千引】的灵魂之力叠加上限固定为100层，但是效果极大幅度提高，每一层提高0.5%残魄获取效率和2%技能伤害。
[*] 【魔道灭魂阵】被动效果修改为残魄获取效率提高30%，并且基础伤害提高
[*] 调整了包括境界法宝武器上的一部分内容
[/list]

notes.title: 12月31日更新公告
notes.content:
在这次更新里，我们新增了无尽模式，优化了游戏难度曲线，新增了大量游戏内容，同样我们也优化了游戏一部分的卡顿，还有一个重磅消息就是我们优化了主角的打击感，这将给大家带来更好的游戏体验，希望大家能够玩得愉快玩得尽兴，如果有任何影响游戏体验的内容都可以告诉我们，我们将尽快进行更改。

[b][h1]主要更新内容[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*]增强主角招式打击感，提高游戏体验
[*]提升所有武器的打击效果
[*]新增挑战房间，挑战房间有各种玩法，丰富游戏性。
[*]新增难度【上古】，击败旱魃后可以继续前行，进入新场景继续战斗。
[*]【神话】难度新增无尽模式，也可以继续战斗。
[*]暂时隐藏精怪图鉴
[*]新增炼化提示
[*]修改大量bug
[*]修复特殊房间卡加载的bug
[*]隐藏最终boss房间，玩家可以无限战斗下去
[*]修复特殊房间可能会掉到地下的bug
[*]优化冰冻表现
[*]优化游戏难度曲线
[*]新增大量战斗音效
[*]炼化武器的收益提升为100%，并且词条上限提升为9条，如果炼化词条失败，将改为增幅所有已存在的武器词条
[*]优化游戏卡顿，并且提升游戏帧数
[/list]

[b][h1]招式与大道[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*]调整【雷之大道】效果
[*]删除招式【风动留影】【破灭影杀】
[*]【能量掌控】新增护盾效果，并且归属于【守护大道】
[*]【九转归元】从仙道招式降低为天阶招式，移除被动和刷新冷却的效果
[*]【刹那永恒】新增冻结时间效果
[*]【泣血笑苍天】从【剑之大道】改为【诅咒大道】
[*]【九天罡风】归属于【空间大道】并且新增被动效果，普通攻击时能够施放无视距离跨越空间的罡风攻击敌人
[*]【缩地成寸】提升为本源规则，并且归属于【空间大道】，新增被动效果，永久替换身法招式
[*]【剑随心动】从【破灭大道】移除
[*]【阴阳神霄雷】从仙道招式降低为天阶招式
[*]【九冥妖风】移除杀戮增益效果
[*]【黄泉业火】归属于【阴阳大道】，新增阴阳平衡与失衡效果
[*]【山岳之剑】从【守护大道】中移除，伤害计算中移除护盾计算
[*]【死亡阴影】重做为【彼岸花开】，并且额外增加回复生命值的效果
[*]新增天阶招式【木火遁术】——木之大道，火之大道，幻影大道
[*]新增仙道招式【天崩地裂】——破灭大道，土之大道
[*]新增仙道招式【不灭金身】——破灭大道，守护大道，金之大道
[*]新增本源规则【破碎虚空】——空间大道，幻影大道，破灭大道
[/list]

[b][h1]玩家境界[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*]新增境界阶级渡劫，天仙，真仙
[*]炼气新增境界【寿元增长】
[*]筑基新增境界【长寿之人】
[*]大乘新增境界【不死不灭】，【我为天】，【自成一道】，【永恒剑域】，【大罗之姿】，【纪元神体】，【黑暗始末】，【丹道仙路】，【涉足轮回】，【本源道心】
[*]境界【庚金剑体】修改为将50%攻击力转化为防御力
[*]境界【本命宝剑】修改为将50%攻击力转化为能量流转，移除能量流转共同计算攻击力的效果
[*]境界【天地大势】修改为将50%防御力转化为能量流转
[*]境界【长虹贯日】防御力计算效率降低为40%
[*]境界【金玉之骨】修改为将2.5%生命值转化为防御力
[*]境界【开地门】修改为降低受到15%伤害
[*]境界【阵道灵体】修改为将50%能量流转转化为防御力
[*]境界【万灵大阵】效果增强
[*]境界【天地桥】效果增强
[*]境界【魂魄入道】的攻击力计算效果提高80%
[/list]

[b][h1]法宝和经脉[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*]法宝【龙延珠】效果调整
[*]法宝【御剑魂】同时视作剑之大道招式
[*]法宝【先天雷连】新增20%暴击伤害
[*]灵墟穴和神藏穴对换位置，精粹提高50%效果提前可以点亮，并且点亮1级只需要200精粹
[*]新增神道穴，选择境界属性时，增加1/2个选项。
[*]新增悬钟穴，获得承灵穴的属性，刷新商店次数增加1/2/3/4/5次
[*]承灵穴效果修改为负面效果以及负面伤害提高2%/4%/6%/8%/10%
[*]新增奇经八脉，需要消耗大量精粹，可以提高极大的游戏体验。
[/list]

notes.title: 海山0.5版本更新公告
notes.content:
[h1][b]亲爱的玩家们：[/b][/h1]
[b]感谢您一直以来对《海山》的支持与热爱！我们非常高兴地宣布0.5版本的游戏更新即将推出，为您带来更加精彩和丰富的游戏体验。[/b]
[olist]
[*][h3]修复bug[/h3]
       在本次更新中，我们聆听了玩家们的反馈并进行了大量修复，解决了许多恶性bug，提升了游戏的稳定性和流畅度。

[*][h3]优化游戏难度[/h3]
并且为了提升玩家的体验，我们更改了每个难度关卡数量，并且提高了游戏资源的获取量，玩家们能够体验到更好的游戏体验。

[*][h3]新增关卡系统[/h3]
为了进一步提升游戏的乐趣和挑战性，我们对游戏玩法进行了全面改进。地图玩法已经全面转变为关卡模式，其中包括战斗、特殊、精英和BOSS等多个关卡。每个地图还将隐藏着各种随机事件，这些事件可能会给玩家带来增益或负面效果，为游戏增添了更多的变数和策略性。

[*][h3]新增武器炼化系统[/h3]
我们还新增了武器炼化系统，玩家可以将不需要的武器炼化为手中武器的词条，提升武器的属性和威力，让您在战斗中更加强大。

[*][h3]新增境界系统[/h3]
为了延伸游戏的进阶体验，我们引入了全新的境界系统。玩家可以通过历练从先天修炼到渡劫，逐步获得强大的力量，最终达到得道成仙的境界。

[*][h3]补全大道招式[/h3]
我们还补全了所有大道与招式，每个大道都拥有独特的玩法和特点，让您可以根据自己的喜好选择最适合的战斗方式。

[*][h3]新增多种多样的法宝[/h3]
同样，法宝系统我们也没忘记，这次新增了不少的新法宝，这些法宝将为您提供更多强大的能力，让您在战斗中更加灵活多样。

[*][h3]优化战斗手感和UI[/h3]
最后，我们对游戏的UI界面进行了修改，并优化了视觉效果，带给您更加舒适和流畅的游戏界面，让您能够更好地沉浸在游戏的世界中。
[/olist]

[h2]但是这还不算完，我们将在后续继续更新更多优质的内容。[/h2]

[list]
[*]新的章节，新的boss，玩家可以体验更多的游戏内容，斩妖除魔拯救世界。

[*]还有无尽模式，通关之后，玩家可以继续在游戏内战斗获得宝物，战至最后。

[*]全新的武器的炼化词条，这些词条可以直接修改招式的形态，优化游玩的手感，为你组建流派提供更多的可能。

[*]存档系统，可以方便玩家进行暂停，更加合理碎片化的游玩游戏。

[*]更多有趣的剧情，更多特殊战斗房间以及独特的精英战斗。
[/list]

[h3][b]我们诚挚地邀请您体验《海山》0.5版本的全新内容，希望这次更新能够给您带来更多的乐趣和惊喜。祝您在游戏中玩得愉快！[/b][/h3]
         [b][h2]   感谢您的支持！[/h2][/b]
                                                                                               [b][u] 《海山》开发团队[/u][/b]
                                                                                                 2023年11月11日
